cards.text: VELANTRA LABOR DAY 2026 — BOF STATICS

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: 21 bottom-of-funnel statics, 7 Nuamore layouts across the Eleanor Weekender, the Vivienne Top Handle and the Meridian Leather Tote. THE LABOR DAY SALE, 30% off sitewide, code LABORDAY30, ends Monday Sept 7. Every ad names the sale and carries the code. Final files are 1080-wide JPEGs in brands/velantra/statics/labor-day-2026/final.

NOTES

cards.title: CODE IS LIVE: LABORDAY30
cards.text: 30% off all products. Live now through Mon Sept 7 2026 11:59pm ET. Unlimited uses, not once-per-customer. Combines with shipping discounts only. Shopify node 1325054394433.

cards.title: THE OFFER
cards.text: Weekender $159.99 to $111.99. Vivienne $149.99 to $104.99. Meridian $124.99 to $87.49. Every ad in the set now names THE LABOR DAY SALE and prints CODE LABORDAY30.

cards.title: OPEN CONFLICT: THANKYOU40
cards.text: THANKYOU40 (40% off) is still live through Sep 4 and beats LABORDAY30 for anyone holding it. Creating the Labor Day code did not resolve this. Kill THANKYOU40 early or accept the overlap.

cards.title: CHECK BEFORE LAUNCH
cards.text: Compare-at prices are restored on all variants, so a Save X% badge will stack on top of the code discount. Verify sale_badge_label on templates/collection.luxe.json, it silently defaults to End of Summer Sale.

cards.title: LAW COMPLIANCE APPLIED
cards.text: BNPL stripped from L1 and L2, we do not offer it. The OTHERS competitor-defect split reframed to same-bag Week 2 vs Year 2 on Brooks's call. Sold-out-9-times and Trustpilot stars removed as fabricated proof, replaced with the real two-year guarantee. No origin claims anywhere in the set.

cards.title: BUYER TESTING ORDER
cards.text: L5 and L2 are the control, cleanest offer read. L6 is the scroll-stopper on cold traffic. L3 is the differentiated swing, sells the guarantee then closes on the sale in its footer bar. L7 for warm and retargeting. L1 closes PDP visitors who did not buy. L4 is brand-safe but soft on urgency.
